correctness.rationale: Lagrange spectral idempotents e_alpha for commuting a_i give a joint decomposition. With d_alpha the fixed diagonal supports, u=sum_alpha d_alpha e_alpha has unit diagonal and satisfies u e_beta=d_beta u; therefore simultaneous conjugation holds over arbitrary characteristic. Stabilizer entries for each x<y are free iff c(x)=c(y). This proves q^{b(c)}, and expanding product_{xy}(q+(1-q)1_{c(x)=c(y)}) proves random-cluster/Tutte. Proper coloring of a comparability graph is equivalent to at least height(P) colors. Independent brute enumeration over F_2 on 3-chain reproduced all 64 fixed-diagonal fibers and 340 tuples; finite checks are not a proof of all posets/fields.
residual_risks: The finite computations alone do not establish unrestricted hypotheses, parameter domains or infinite quantifiers; proof reconstruction supplies those steps.
